description: The default analyst role for the finance department at Northwind Logistics. Owns recognized-revenue P&L, segment-margin reconstruction, ARR/MRR roll-ups, and renewal recognition. Reads only from `public.revenue` (recognition events) joined to `public.contracts` — NEVER from `public.orders` (booking signal) or `public.invoices` (collection signal). Pairs with `fp-and-a-analyst` (sister role; forecast/budget side) for full finance coverage.
